meta.title: RoamView Interconnect
meta.frame: +X forward, +Y up, +Z robot right, mm. Origin: floor under the drive-axle centre (ROS base_footprint).
meta.source: model_b.py (Rev B layout, checked by rules_b.py); routes from build_b.py

plates.name: Lower deck (baseplate)
plates.desc: 6061-T6 plate, 320 x 260 x 6 mm. Rev B: wells lengthened to 150 mm for the 125 mm wheels, spring holes, 3-inch caster pattern, new pass-throughs and mounting holes

plates.name: Top deck
plates.desc: 6061-T6 plate, 320 x 260 x 3 mm. Rev B: new pass-throughs, hanging power blocks, handle and e-stop holes

parts.name: Deck post FL
parts.desc: 2020 aluminium extrusion, 120 mm

parts.name: Deck post FR
parts.desc: 2020 aluminium extrusion, 120 mm

parts.name: Deck post RL
parts.desc: 2020 aluminium extrusion, 120 mm

parts.name: Deck post RR
parts.desc: 2020 aluminium extrusion, 120 mm

parts.name: Drive wheel, left
parts.desc: 125 x 30 mm drive wheel on a 6 mm D-shaft hub (placeholder: pick a wheel with a hub for the 37D shaft). Rev B: was 100 x 26 mm

parts.name: Drive module, left
parts.desc: 37 mm gearmotor with 64 CPR encoder (placeholder, recheck torque: 125 mm wheels need about 25 % more) bolted to a 5 mm aluminium module plate. The plate is the trailing arm: it pivots 66 mm behind the axle and its front tab carries the spring. 10 mm bump travel, 5 mm droop

parts.name: Pivot hanger, left
parts.desc: Aluminium hanger bolted under the lower deck (2 x M4); 8 mm shoulder-bolt pivot with bronze bushings

parts.name: Suspension spring, left
parts.desc: Compression spring (about 43 mm installed, 16 mm OD) on an M5 guide bolt. It pushes the module tab down through an 18 mm hole in the lower deck and seats in a cup on the deck top; the nut on the bolt is the droop stop. Rate and preload to set after weighing the robot

parts.name: Drive wheel, right
parts.desc: 125 x 30 mm drive wheel on a 6 mm D-shaft hub (placeholder: pick a wheel with a hub for the 37D shaft). Rev B: was 100 x 26 mm

parts.name: Drive module, right
parts.desc: 37 mm gearmotor with 64 CPR encoder (placeholder, recheck torque: 125 mm wheels need about 25 % more) bolted to a 5 mm aluminium module plate. The plate is the trailing arm: it pivots 66 mm behind the axle and its front tab carries the spring. 10 mm bump travel, 5 mm droop

parts.name: Pivot hanger, right
parts.desc: Aluminium hanger bolted under the lower deck (2 x M4); 8 mm shoulder-bolt pivot with bronze bushings

parts.name: Suspension spring, right
parts.desc: Compression spring (about 43 mm installed, 16 mm OD) on an M5 guide bolt. It pushes the module tab down through an 18 mm hole in the lower deck and seats in a cup on the deck top; the nut on the bolt is the droop stop. Rate and preload to set after weighing the robot

parts.name: Caster, front
parts.desc: Low-profile 3-inch swivel plate caster, about 89 mm tall (3-1/2 in class), on a 4 mm spacer: mount face 93 mm. Placeholder until a caster is chosen. Rev B: was a 2-inch caster at X +-130

parts.name: Caster, rear
parts.desc: Low-profile 3-inch swivel plate caster, about 89 mm tall (3-1/2 in class), on a 4 mm spacer: mount face 93 mm. Placeholder until a caster is chosen. Rev B: was a 2-inch caster at X +-130

parts.name: Battery tray
parts.desc: 3 mm printed or aluminium tray on four M3 screws: rear stop and a 6 mm front lip hold the pack against 3 g

parts.name: Battery, 4S2P 18650
parts.desc: 14.8 V nominal, about 7 Ah, pre-built pack with protection board and thermistor. 90 x 75 x 42 mm, in a tray with a rear stop and a 6 mm front lip, held by two straps. To remove: unplug the XT60, undo the straps, lift over the lip and slide it out the front between the decks

parts.name: Power board
parts.desc: Perma-Proto half-size board (81 x 51 mm) on nylon standoffs: main fuse F1 (15 A) and branch fuses F3/F4 (3 A) in PCB blade holders, K1 motor relay with its 15 ohm coil resistor and flyback parts, and INA260 #1 on the motor rail. Every path over 3 A is wire soldered straight to the relay and fuse-holder pins, not board traces. Wires enter the terminal blocks on the aisle side

parts.name: Bus and ground splices
parts.desc: Two WAGO 221-415 lever splices in a screw-down carrier. Pack node +: pack, dock charge input and the feed to F1. Star ground: pack return, power-board ground, dock return and the frame-bond lug (the only frame connection)

parts.name: Pack connector XT60
parts.desc: Pack disconnect, riding on the pack's rear end on its own lead. Unplug it first; the pack half leaves with the pack

parts.name: Motor driver
parts.desc: DFRobot DFR0601 dual-channel driver, 12 A per channel, 6.5-37 V, 50 x 50 x 12.5 mm. Control: PWM, INA, INB per channel from the ESP32

parts.name: Charge input guard
parts.desc: D1 (Pololu 5382 ideal diode, 10 A) and F2 (5 A ATO in an inline holder) on the + contact lead: the pack can never back-feed the exposed contacts

parts.name: Charge contact +
parts.desc: Brass L-contact on two M4 holes with an insulating washer. Face 62-99 mm above the floor, 3 mm behind the bumper face; the dock's spring pins reach it through the bumper window

parts.name: Charge contact -
parts.desc: Brass L-contact on two M4 holes with an insulating washer. Face 62-99 mm above the floor, 3 mm behind the bumper face; the dock's spring pins reach it through the bumper window

parts.name: Front bumper
parts.desc: 5 mm PETG bumper face 250 mm wide, 56-100 mm above the floor, on two flexure brackets under the lower deck, each clamped by its corner post's M5 bolt plus one M4 screw. Two Omron SS-5GL2 switches close when it moves 2 mm. Windows let the dock's pins reach the charge contacts; the centre notch clears the front caster's swing

parts.name: Cliff sensor FL
parts.desc: Adafruit VL53L4CD time-of-flight sensor (25.5 x 17.7 mm) hanging under the lower deck, looking straight down at the floor 87 mm below. I2C at 3.3 V with its own XSHUT line

parts.name: Cliff sensor FR
parts.desc: Adafruit VL53L4CD time-of-flight sensor (25.5 x 17.7 mm) hanging under the lower deck, looking straight down at the floor 87 mm below. I2C at 3.3 V with its own XSHUT line

parts.name: Cliff sensor RL
parts.desc: Adafruit VL53L4CD time-of-flight sensor (25.5 x 17.7 mm) hanging under the lower deck, looking straight down at the floor 87 mm below. I2C at 3.3 V with its own XSHUT line

parts.name: Cliff sensor RR
parts.desc: Adafruit VL53L4CD time-of-flight sensor (25.5 x 17.7 mm) hanging under the lower deck, looking straight down at the floor 87 mm below. I2C at 3.3 V with no XSHUT line: its board pull-up keeps it on and the firmware gives it a new address first, then releases the other three one at a time

parts.name: Deck plug, power (6-pin)
parts.desc: Inline Molex Micro-Fit 3.0 (2 x 3), tied to the rear-left post: compute feed, sensor feed and e-stop loop. Unplug it to lift the top deck

parts.name: Deck plug, signals (24-pin)
parts.desc: Inline Molex Micro-Fit 3.0 (2 x 12), tied to the rear-right post: encoders, driver control, I2C, 3.3 V and 5 V, cliff-sensor XSHUT lines, bumper switches. Unplug it to lift the top deck. Rev B: 24 pins (was 20)

parts.name: LiDAR riser
parts.desc: 3D-printed riser 50 x 50 x 40 mm, PETG 40 % infill, through-bolted, 12 mm cable bore on its axis. Rev B: 40 mm tall (was 60) so the scan plane stays near 286 mm

parts.name: D500 LiDAR
parts.desc: D500 DTOF LiDAR: 360 deg, 0.03-12 m, 10 Hz, UART 230400. Scan plane about 286 mm above the floor

parts.name: OAK-D Pro W
parts.desc: Stereo depth + 12 MP colour, IMU, IR projector. USB-C on its back face

parts.name: E-stop
parts.desc: 22 mm latching mushroom e-stop with two NC blocks: NC1 opens K1's coil, NC2 reports to the ESP32. Rev B: moved to X -105 so the handle and the Pi's ports stay clear of it

parts.name: Raspberry Pi 5
parts.desc: Raspberry Pi 5 on 6 mm nylon standoffs, turned so the USB/Ethernet ports face the rear edge, the USB-C power and micro-HDMI ports face the left edge, and the SD card faces forward

parts.name: Pi GPIO HAT
parts.desc: Adafruit Perma-Proto HAT on an extra-tall stacking header, with a 35 mm hole over the cooler fan. Locking JST-XH headers for UART0 (ESP32 link), UART2 (LiDAR) and the recording light

parts.name: ESP32-S3 controller
parts.desc: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1-N32R16V in sockets on a Perma-Proto carrier at the top deck's rear-right. Its two USB-C ports face the rear edge so a laptop plugs in with the robot assembled. The carrier holds the 74LVC244 that shifts the 5 V encoder signals and K2's 5 V status output, the I2C pull-ups and locking headers

parts.name: RC receiver (wireless e-stop)
parts.desc: 2.4 GHz receiver with failsafe (47 x 26 x 15 mm, placeholder). Antennas vertical, tips below the LiDAR band

parts.name: OAK power Y-adapter
parts.desc: Luxonis USB-C Y-adapter: camera port faces right, host port faces the rear, power port faces left

parts.name: Microphone array
parts.desc: Proposed replacement for the Anker S330, which is 120 mm across and does not fit: a 70 mm USB 4-mic array with echo cancellation (e.g. Seeed ReSpeaker USB Mic Array v2.0). Team decision

parts.name: USB speaker
parts.desc: Small USB-powered speaker for two-way audio (placeholder). Team decision together with the mic array

parts.name: Recording light
parts.desc: 16 mm panel indicator, lit whenever video or audio leaves the robot

parts.name: Status light
parts.desc: 16 mm panel indicator driven by the ESP32: ready, moving, fault, e-stop

parts.name: Carry handle
parts.desc: 16 mm grip across the rear, 38 mm above the top deck, bolted through the deck into the rear posts so the load goes into the frame. Top at 268 mm, below the LiDAR band. Lift here, never by the LiDAR

parts.name: Compute power block
parts.desc: Hangs under the top deck: INA260 #2, ideal diode D2 and the 4700 uF hold-up capacitor on Buck A's 14.8 V input (about 30 ms of Pi power through a motor-inrush sag), then Buck A (Pololu D36V50F5) to 5.1 V for the Pi

parts.name: Sensor power block
parts.desc: Hangs under the top deck: INA260 #3 and Buck B (Pololu D36V50F5) to 5 V for the OAK-D, LiDAR, ESP32 side, encoders and RC relay

parts.name: RC e-stop relay K2
parts.desc: Pololu RC switch with relay (#2804) hanging under the top deck. Its contact sits in series with the e-stop NC1 in K1's coil loop, so losing the radio link or flipping the transmitter switch stops the motors. Its OUT pin (5 V) reports the relay state to the ESP32 through the 74LVC244

parts.name: LiDAR splice
parts.desc: Splits the LiDAR's 4-wire lead: TX to the Pi, 5 V and ground to Buck B

parts.name: Charging dock
parts.desc: 16.8 V CC/CV 3 A charger, spring pins that reach through the bumper windows, AprilTag target. Shown docked

cables.name: Pack to splices
cables.spec: 14.8 V nominal (12.0-16.8 V), up to 15 A
cables.conn: XT60 robot half to the WAGO pack node and star ground
cables.notes: The XT60 is the service disconnect: unplug it before touching the power board.

a.terminal: XT60 robot half + / XT60 robot half -

cables.name: Motor rail
cables.spec: 14.8 V switched by K1, 3 A typical, 10 A peak (both motors)
cables.conn: TB2 on the power board to the driver's VM/GND screws
cables.notes: Dead whenever the e-stop is pressed or the RC link drops: K1's coil loop opens in hardware.

a.terminal: TB2-1 MOT+ (after K1, INA260 #1) / TB2-2 MOT-

cables.name: Left motor
cables.conn: Driver M1 screws to the motor leads (Micro-Fit 2-pin at the module)
cables.notes: Leave a 40 mm loop at the module: it moves 10 mm up and 5 mm down.

cables.name: Right motor
cables.conn: Driver M2 screws to the motor leads (Micro-Fit 2-pin at the module)
cables.notes: Leave a 40 mm loop at the module.

cables.name: Compute feed, lower
cables.conn: TB3 to deck power plug pins 1-2

cables.name: Compute feed, upper
cables.spec: 14.8 V into INA260 #2, D2, C1 and Buck A
cables.conn: Deck power plug pins 1-2 to the compute block

cables.name: Pi 5 power
cables.conn: Buck A output to a USB-C plug
cables.notes: The Pi cannot negotiate 5 A over a plain pigtail, so it limits USB to 600 mA; add usb_max_current_enable=1 if needed.

cables.name: Sensor feed, lower
cables.conn: TB3 to deck power plug pins 3-4

cables.name: Sensor feed, upper
cables.spec: 14.8 V into INA260 #3 and Buck B
cables.conn: Deck power plug pins 3-4 to the sensor block

cables.name: OAK-D power
cables.spec: 5 V, 0.9 A typical, 3 A worst case
cables.conn: Buck B output to the Y-adapter's power port
cables.notes: Keeps up to 15 W off the Pi's USB.

cables.name: LiDAR power
cables.conn: Buck B output to the LiDAR splice

cables.name: Controller power
cables.spec: 5 V, 0.6 A: ESP32, encoders, cliff sensors (3.3 V from the DevKit), level shifter
cables.conn: JST-XH 2-pin at the carrier

cables.name: RC relay power
cables.conn: JST-XH 2-pin
cables.notes: Also powers the receiver through the servo lead.

cables.name: Power board feed
cables.spec: 14.8 V into F1 (15 A) and the power-board ground
cables.conn: WAGO to TB1

cables.name: Charge contact +
cables.spec: 16.8 V CC/CV from the dock, 3 A
cables.conn: M4 ring lug on the contact to the F2 holder lead

cables.name: Charge contact -
cables.conn: M4 ring lug to the star ground

cables.name: Charge to pack
cables.spec: 16.8 V, 3 A into the pack node ahead of F1
cables.conn: D1 OUT to the WAGO pack node
cables.notes: The robot keeps running on dock power while it charges.

cables.name: E-stop loop, lower
cables.conn: TB4 to deck power plug pins 5-6

a.terminal: TB4-1 K1 coil feed / TB4-2 K1 coil return

b.terminal: Pin 5 loop out / Pin 6 loop return

cables.name: E-stop loop, upper
cables.conn: Deck power plug pins 5-6 to the e-stop block

a.terminal: Pin 5 loop out / Pin 6 loop return

cables.name: E-stop loop to K2
cables.conn: E-stop block to K2's screw terminals
cables.notes: Press the e-stop, switch the transmitter off or lose the radio link: the loop opens and K1 drops the motor rail.

a.terminal: NC1 out to K2 / Loop return from K2

cables.name: OAK-D to Y-adapter
cables.spec: USB 3.2 Gen 1, 5 Gbit/s: video, depth, IMU
cables.conn: USB-C both ends

cables.name: Y-adapter to Pi
cables.spec: USB 3.2 Gen 1 to the Pi's blue port
cables.conn: USB-C to USB-A

cables.name: LiDAR lead
cables.spec: TX 3.3 V UART 230400 8N1, PWM (unused), GND, 5 V
cables.conn: ZH1.5T-4P at the LiDAR, splice at J2
cables.pins: Pin 1 TX, pin 2 PWM (open), pin 3 GND, pin 4 5 V
cables.notes: Down the riser bore and the 20 mm deck hole.

cables.name: LiDAR scan data
cables.spec: UART 230400, LiDAR to Pi only (/scan at 10 Hz)
cables.conn: Splice to the HAT's JST-XH
cables.pins: LiDAR TX to Pi pin 29 (GPIO5, UART2 RX); GND to pin 30. dtoverlay=uart2-pi5

cables.name: micro-ROS link
cables.spec: UART 921600, full duplex: /cmd_vel down at 50 Hz, odometry and IMU up at 100 Hz
cables.conn: JST-XH 3-pin both ends
cables.pins: Pi pin 8 (GPIO14 TX) to ESP32 GPIO18; Pi pin 10 (GPIO15 RX) to GPIO17; pin 6 GND. dtoverlay=uart0-pi5
cables.notes: The 300 ms command watchdog lives on the ESP32 end.

cables.name: Deck signal cable
cables.spec: Everything the ESP32 needs from the lower deck
cables.conn: Micro-Fit 24 at the deck plug, 2 x 12 IDC at the carrier
cables.pins: Encoders 4, driver 6, I2C 2, XSHUT 3, bumper 2, 5 V, 3V3, GND x 2, 3 spare
cables.notes: Unplug at the deck plug to lift the top deck.

cables.name: Motor commands
cables.spec: PWM 20 kHz plus INA/INB per channel, 3.3 V logic
cables.conn: Deck plug branch to the driver's control header
cables.pins: GPIO4 PWM1, GPIO5 INA1, GPIO6 INB1, GPIO7 PWM2, GPIO15 INA2, GPIO16 INB2, GND

b.terminal: PWM1 INA1 INB1 PWM2 INA2 INB2 GND

cables.name: Left encoder
cables.conn: Micro-Fit 4-pin at the module, deck plug branch
cables.pins: GND, 5 V, A to GPIO10 and B to GPIO11 through the 74LVC244
cables.notes: Leave a 40 mm loop at the module.

cables.name: Right encoder
cables.conn: Micro-Fit 4-pin at the module, deck plug branch
cables.pins: GND, 5 V, A to GPIO12 and B to GPIO13 through the 74LVC244

cables.name: Motor current sense
cables.conn: Deck plug branch to JST-XH 4

cables.name: Cliff sensor FL
cables.conn: Deck plug branch to the STEMMA QT (JST-SH 4) plus the XSHUT header pin

cables.name: Cliff sensor FR
cables.conn: Deck plug branch to the STEMMA QT (JST-SH 4) plus the XSHUT header pin

cables.name: Cliff sensor RL
cables.conn: Deck plug branch to the STEMMA QT (JST-SH 4) plus the XSHUT header pin

cables.name: Cliff sensor RR
cables.conn: Deck plug branch to the STEMMA QT (JST-SH 4)
cables.pins: 3V3, GND, SDA, SCL. No XSHUT: the firmware readdresses this sensor first
cables.notes: Rev B: its XSHUT line (GPIO40) went to K2's status signal.

cables.name: Bumper switch L
cables.spec: Contact closure, pull-up on the ESP32
cables.conn: Deck plug branch to the switch tabs

cables.name: Bumper switch R
cables.spec: Contact closure, pull-up on the ESP32
cables.conn: Deck plug branch to the switch tabs

cables.name: E-stop echo
cables.conn: NC2 block to JST-XH 2
cables.notes: Reporting only. Stopping never depends on this wire.

cables.name: Status light
cables.conn: JST-XH to the indicator's tabs

cables.name: Recording light
cables.conn: JST-XH to the indicator's tabs
cables.pins: Pi pin 16 (GPIO23) drives the transistor; 5 V from pin 4
cables.notes: Driven by the Pi because the Pi knows when a stream is live.

cables.name: Microphone array
cables.spec: USB audio class, 16 kHz, 4 mics + echo reference
cables.conn: micro-USB to USB-A

cables.name: Speaker
cables.conn: USB-A

cables.name: RC receiver to K2
cables.spec: RC PWM, 5 V and ground to the receiver
cables.conn: Servo plug both ends

cables.name: K2 status
cables.spec: OUT (relay on). K2's outputs swing to 5 V through 220 ohm
cables.conn: JST-XH 3
cables.pins: OUT to GPIO40 through a spare 74LVC244 channel; GOOD is a spare conductor, not connected at the carrier; GND
cables.notes: Never straight to an ESP32 pin: K2's outputs are 5 V, and GPIO47/48 run at 1.8 V on the N32R16V.

b.terminal: K2 OUT to GPIO40 via the 74LVC244

cables.name: Top-deck I2C
cables.conn: JST-XH 4 both ends

cables.name: I2C to compute block
cables.conn: JST-XH 4 both ends
